header.name: Earth (planet view) V23
header.description: Earth on its own, increment 23 of 23. Six real launch sites (Kennedy, Baikonur, Kourou, Jiuquan, Vandenberg, Wenchang): each rocket climbs its local vertical and comes back to its pad, one after another. Only the large satellites are kept: the ISS, Tiangong, Hubble and a geostationary weather satellite, on faded orbit lines. The mountains are small peaks along real ranges. Sizes are exaggerated where the real size would vanish.
